subject: NMT
source_sentence: Neural machine translation (NMT) uses an encoder-decoder architecture, in which the encoder encodes the source sentence x = (x1,..., xn) to a continuous representation sequence z = (z1,..., zk) and the decoder translates the representation z into a sentence y = (y1,..., ym) in the target language.
title: English-Indonesian Neural Machine Translation for Spoken Language Domains

subject: RNN
source_sentence: Several previous works implemented recurrent neural networks (RNN) in their encoder-decoder architecture
title: English-Indonesian Neural Machine Translation for Spoken Language Domains
